history.summary: Altura is a 2027-TOP EC in Bukit Batok West offering a 4BR at $1.68M / $1,397 psf — an attractive quantum for a brand-new executive condo near the Tengah/Jurong growth corridor. EC mechanics (MOP, citizen-only first hand) plus a 1.34km MRT walk and null URA data temper an otherwise solid entry.
history.rating_rationale: At $1,397 psf and $1.68M quantum, this new EC sits well below comparable D23/Jurong private condo PSF, and ECs structurally re-rate toward private pricing post-MOP — a reliable 5-7yr appreciation driver. Tengah town buildout and JRL (~2028) are real catalysts; the main drags are the 1.34km MRT walk and EC resale restrictions during MOP.
red_flags: 1.34km / 16-min walk to nearest MRT (Tengah Park, JRL)
EC minimum occupation period restricts resale/leasing in early years
No URA series yet — appreciation is inferred from EC re-rating pattern, not transacted
catalysts: Tengah new-town buildout and Jurong Region Line (~2028) within the catchment
Low $1.68M quantum keeps the resale buyer pool deep (HDB upgraders)
